event.name: Norte Fire
event.address: 3000 Block of Eminencia Del Norte, San Clemente

data.evacuation_notes: Orange County Evacuation Map

reports.msg: Six air tankers have been released and the no-divert status has been lifted, per Air Attack.

The fire has been mapped at 465.5 acres by FIRIS OES Intel 24. Their perimeter is visible on the Watch Duty map under the Active Fire Perimeters map layer.

Note: Fire perimeters are preliminary and indicate general burn area but do not reflect structure protection efforts by firefighters. A structure within a fire perimeter may not be damaged or destroyed.

Nine Capistrano Unified School District schools are dismissing students early Friday, Oct. 16, as the Norte Fire prompts evacuations near San Clemente and San Juan Capistrano.

The affected schools are:

  • Bernice Ayer Middle School

  • Clarence Lobo Elementary School

  • Concordia Elementary School

  • Harold Ambuehl Elementary School

  • San Clemente High School

  • San Juan Hills High School

  • Shorecliffs Middle School

  • Truman Benedict Elementary School

  • Vista Del Mar

Parents and guardians of elementary school students are being asked to report directly to their schools for pickup. At secondary schools, families may pick up students or authorize their release by responding to school communications.

Families should continue monitoring messages from Capistrano Unified and follow official evacuation instructions from public safety agencies.

Update via Orange County Department of Education on Facebook.

Evacuation shelters are available at the following locations:

  • San Juan Capistrano Community Center 25925 Camino del Avion, San Juan Capistrano.

  • San Clemente Community Center 100 Calle Seville, San Clemente.

Update via OCFA on X.

Units have been requested to the area of La Novia and Via Cerro Rebal for an immediate structure threat.

An additional resource request has been placed for 50 type-1 engines, 15 type-3 wildland engines, 3 hand crews, and 6 dozers. A road closure has been requested for Avenida La Pata, southbound between Ortega Hwy and Avenida Vista Hermosa, per radio traffic.
A hard road closure has been requested from I-5 at San Juan Creek Rd to Camino De Los Mares, per radio traffic.

An Evacuation Order is in place for Zones SJC04, SJC05, SJC 10, SCL12, and SCL13, per the Orange County Evacuation Map. These zones are also visible on the Watch Duty map.

The fire is now 250 acres, per OC Fire Authority on X.

An Evacuation of all streets off Camino Las Ramblas down to I-5 and around to the San Juan dump has been requested. The fire is impacting homes in the area of Avenida Calita, Via La Mirada, and Via De Agua in San Juan Capistrano. Per radio traffic.

Multiple structures are impacted in the area of Via La Mirada and Calle Esperanza. Additionally units are responding to reported structure threats in the area of Avenida California and Paseo Aliso. 10 additional type-1 strike teams (50 engines) have been requested, per radio traffic.

Three type-1 strike teams (15 engines) have been requested for structure protection, per Incident Command. Additionally fixed wing aircraft on the Norte Fire have been placed on a no divert status, due to immediate structure threats, per Air Attack.
The fire is now 50-70 acres in light flashy fuels with a dangerous rate of spread and multiple structures threatened. Three additional air tankers have been requested, per Air Attack.

The fire is now 10 acres, slope and wind driven, with a moderate rate of spread, and a potential for 50 acres. Air resources have been requested, per Incident Command.

Note: This incident is now known as the Norte Fire.
The fire is 2-4 acres in light flashy fuels with a rapid rate of spread. Structures are threatened off Via Entrada. A second alarm response has been requested, per Incident Command.
Resources are responding to a reported vegetation fire with smoke showing on the attached camera.
